kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
استحثثن (form X)
# اِسْتَحْثَثْنَ (istaḥṯaṯna) /is.taħ.θaθ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# اُسْتُحْثِثْنَ (ustuḥṯiṯna) /us.tuħ.θiθ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# اِسْتَحْثِثْنَ (istaḥṯiṯna) /is.taħ.θiθ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
